metadata.purpose: Select leading and/or latest trailing source values using one active duration Observable.

conditions: Source values only are forwarded; duration payloads are ignored.
Busy values do not extend a duration. A trailing output starts another duration while the source is live.
Source completion waits only when trailing output is enabled, a value is pending and a duration is active.
With both flags false, no next notification is emitted.

scope.parameters: leading=true, trailing=true. Valid Observable-returning duration selector; every returned token identifies its producer description.
scope.callbacks: Selector invocation and correlated return/throw are explicit. Its payload is the value that starts a duration, including a trailing output.
scope.time: All event times are supplied nonnegative safe integers. Equal-time order is input order. Source and duration Observables supply time; selector outcomes remain at invocation time. No internal clock is created.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Promise/Iterable conversion and invalid duration inputs.
Synchronous duration delivery during subscription acquisition; separately characterized natively.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: No connection during construction. The first result subscription applies the profile-specific acquisition rule.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Return from the currently pending, correlated synchronous callback.
Throw from the currently pending, correlated synchronous callback.
Current duration emits its first next; payload is irrelevant.
Current duration completes without a next.
Current duration fails with an opaque error.

See the typed state and named transitions for Selecting.

Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.guard: first result connection; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: subscribe source; create no duration yet
rules.nextState: Open with empty pending memory and next duration generation zero.
rules.explanation: The first value, not subscription itself, starts throttling.

rules.guard: no active duration; leading=true; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: clear pending presence and emit the incoming value
invoke duration selector with that value
rules.nextState: Duration generation advances; pending memory is empty after leading output.
rules.explanation: A leading emission precedes duration selection/acquisition. With leading=false the same source value still starts a duration.

rules.guard: current selector invocation returns a valid Observable token at the same time; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: subscribe returned duration Observable
rules.nextState: Throttled with the current generation, returned token and unchanged pending memory.
rules.explanation: The returned Observable describes the duration. Each accepted invocation creates a separate duration subscription, even when the token is reused.

rules.guard: current selector invocation throws at the same time; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: forward exact selector error
release source
rules.nextState: Closed error; do not acquire a duration.
rules.explanation: A leading value may already have been observed before the selector fails.

rules.guard: a duration is active; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: replace pending value without restarting duration or emitting
rules.nextState: Same duration generation/deadline; pending presence=true with newest payload.
rules.explanation: Busy source values update latest memory. They do not call the selector or postpone the current timer.

rules.guard: current duration ends with a pending value and trailing=true; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release current duration
clear pending presence and emit latest value
invoke selector for emitted trailing value
rules.nextState: Pending memory is empty; a new duration generation starts while source remains live.
rules.explanation: A trailing output starts another throttle duration. It is not merely an audit-style return to idle.

rules.guard: current duration ends without a pending value; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release current duration; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Open with no active duration; preserve any un-emitted internal memory until replaced.
rules.explanation: No trailing emission means no automatic new duration. A later source value starts the next duration.

rules.guard: current duration completes without a next; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release completed duration; do not flush pending value
rules.nextState: Open; the pending reference is retained internally, not emitted.
rules.explanation: Duration complete uses cleanupThrottling, not endThrottling: next and complete are distinct control signals.

rules.guard: source completes with no active duration; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: complete result without flushing retained value
release source
rules.nextState: Closed complete; all pending memory discarded.
rules.explanation: There is no active duration to justify waiting, even if an empty duration previously left internal pending memory.

rules.guard: trailing=true and a value is pending behind a live duration; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release completed source; keep duration live
rules.nextState: Waiting with source closed, one duration owned and latest value retained.
rules.explanation: Source completion is not an immediate flush. The pending trailing value still waits for the duration signal.

rules.guard: current duration ends after source completion; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release current duration
emit the retained trailing value
complete result; do not start another duration
rules.nextState: Closed complete; source was already released, duration and memory are now gone.
rules.explanation: The trailing value precedes final completion, but source termination prevents restarting a duration.

rules.guard: current duration completes without next after source completion; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: complete result without trailing output
release completed duration
rules.nextState: Closed complete; pending value discarded.
rules.explanation: Empty duration completion can finish the waiting result, but it never substitutes for a next-triggered flush. The completion handler precedes its own finalization.

rules.guard: there is no pending value; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: complete result immediately
release source
release active duration
rules.nextState: Closed complete; no pending value is emitted.
rules.explanation: A lone leading value does not require waiting for its duration to expire.

rules.guard: source fails; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: forward exact source error
release source and any active duration without flushing
rules.nextState: Closed error; pending value discarded.
rules.explanation: Failure is never delayed until a duration ends.

rules.guard: source fails; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: forward exact source error
release source and any active duration without flushing
rules.nextState: Closed error; pending value discarded.
rules.explanation: Failure is never delayed until a duration ends.

rules.guard: consumer cancels this execution; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release only still-owned source/duration resources; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Closed cancel; clear all memory.
rules.explanation: Cancellation during completion-waiting releases only the duration; the source has already ended.

rules.guard: consumer cancels this execution; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release only still-owned source/duration resources; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Closed cancel; clear all memory.
rules.explanation: Cancellation during completion-waiting releases only the duration; the source has already ended.

rules.guard: consumer cancels this execution; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: release only still-owned source/duration resources; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Closed cancel; clear all memory.
rules.explanation: Cancellation during completion-waiting releases only the duration; the source has already ended.

rules.guard: currently owned duration fails; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: forward exact duration error
release still-live source and duration without flushing
rules.nextState: Closed error; pending value discarded.
rules.explanation: Duration errors use the error channel, including after the source has already completed.

rules.guard: currently owned duration fails; valid nondecreasing supplied time
actions: forward exact duration error
release still-live source and duration without flushing
rules.nextState: Closed error; pending value discarded.
rules.explanation: Duration errors use the error channel, including after the source has already completed.
